links.outcome: Agreement of Sepsis-3 implementation labels with expert labels and effect on model performance
links.effect: Models trained on Sepsis-3 labels underperform expert-trained models by up to 18 AUROC and 13 F1 points against ground-truth labels; aligning implementations reduces the gap to 3 AUROC and 2 F1 points.
links.quote: This disagreement propagates to machine learning: models trained on Sepsis-3 labels significantly underperform expert-trained models by up to 18 AUROC and 13 F1 points against ground-truth labels.

links.outcome: Comparability of published AI results using Sepsis-3 labels due to undocumented implementation differences
links.effect: Seemingly identical Sepsis-3 labels differ across studies, making published AI results difficult to compare; transparent reporting of implementations is essential for reproducibility.
links.quote: Published AI results are difficult to compare because seemingly identical Sepsis-3 labels differ across studies.

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating how implementation variability in Sepsis-3 phenotyping definitions affects predictive AI model performance compared to expert-aligned labels.

primary.practice: aligning consensus label definitions with expert labels
